scheduling.skillGoal: Split a large markdown document into smaller files at level 2 sections via @kayvan/markdown-tree-parser, then handle the original per user choice
scheduling.intentSignature: Split a large markdown document into level-2 section shards
intentSignatures: Split a large markdown document into level-2 section shards
Break a large markdown file into smaller organized files
Run @kayvan/markdown-tree-parser explode against a markdown document
triggerPatterns: the user requests sharding of a large markdown document

ioContract.inputsRaw: Source markdown document path (.md). Destination folder path — default is same location as source, folder named after source file without .md extension. User choice on original document: [d]elete, [m]ove to archive, or [k]eep.
ioContract.outputsRaw: Sharded section files in destination folder; index.md in destination folder; completion report containing source path, destination path, file count, index.md confirmation, and any tool warnings; original-document disposition outcome (deleted | moved-to-archive | kept-with-warning).

preconditions: source document exists and has .md extension
destination folder exists or can be created with write permission
npx is available and able to fetch @kayvan/markdown-tree-parser

structural.sceneGoal: Obtain and validate the source markdown document path
Determine the destination folder (default or user-provided), verify or create it, and check write permissions
Run npx @kayvan/markdown-tree-parser explode and capture output and errors
Verify destination contains shards and an index.md, and count files; halt if none created
Display the completion report including paths, count, and tool output
Prompt for and execute the user's choice on the original document — delete, move to archive, or keep with warning

logical.description: If the source document path was not provided, ask the user to supply it
Verify the source file exists, is accessible, and has a .md extension; HALT with error if not found or not markdown
Compute the default destination folder as the source file's directory plus a folder named after the source file without .md extension, and prompt the user to confirm or override
Verify the destination folder exists or can be created and that write permission is granted; HALT with error if permission denied
Inform the user that sharding is beginning
Execute `npx @kayvan/markdown-tree-parser explode <source-document> <destination-folder>` and capture output and errors; HALT on failure
List the destination folder, verify shards exist and index.md was created, and count the number of section files
If no files were created, HALT with an error message
Display a completion report listing source path, destination path, shard count, index.md confirmation, and any tool output or warnings
Present the user with options for the original document — [d] delete (recommended), [m] move to archive, or [k] keep (not recommended)
If the user selects [d], delete the original source document file and confirm deletion to the user
If the user selects [m], create the archive directory if needed, move the original to the chosen archive path (default: source_dir/archive/<filename>), and confirm
If the user selects [k], display the keeping-original warnings and confirm the user's choice
